consumer: The frontend paperdoll panel reads avatar.carried_items[] and asks 'which carried item is in the wielded slot and which fill the worn slots' purely to render the doll.
scope: only the character's own carried items, partitioned by location (wielded/worn/inventory)
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items — iterates the avatar's own wielded_items(), worn, and inv_const_slice() and emits each item tagged with a 'location' string ('wielded'|'worn'|'inventory') as a formatted display view for the GUI.
divergence: Avatar is wearing a jacket but it is emitted under location 'inventory' (or omitted), so the paperdoll renders an empty worn torso slot for armor actually being worn — a wrong location/display answer the displayed doll would expose.
